//: Per-repo config for the audit plugin. This example keeps its manifest at the root of the example directory rather than the usual docs/audit/, so manifestPath has to say so — without it /audit:panel finds no manifest and silently renders without phase titles, task metadata, unit economics or model routing.
//usage: Rates are USD per MILLION tokens. Kept in sync with meta.usage in the manifest: commands read the manifest, hooks read this file. Both default to .claude/usage, so they only need to agree when a project moves the ledger.
